title: DepEd flags fake 'nationwide class suspension' announcement for Teacher's Day
summary: The Department of Education (DepEd) has issued a warning against a fake announcement that has been circulating, especially in social media on a "nationwide class suspension," DZBB Super Radyo's…

blocks.text: The Department of Education (DepEd) has issued a warning against a fake announcement that has been circulating, especially in social media on a "nationwide class suspension," DZBB Super Radyo's Luisito Santos reported.
"Nilinaw ng Department of Education na hindi totoo ang kumakalat na impormasyon sa kaugnay sa umanoy nationwide class suspension sa October 5-6, 2026 dahil sa Teacher’s Day," the DepEd said.
(The Department of Education has clarified that the information circulating regarding the alleged nationwide class suspension on October 5-6, 2026 due to Teacher's Day is false.)
